The visuals are breathtaking for a game that was released in 2016, the gameplay is intense, and the pacing keeps you locked in. I didn’t expect a WWI shooter to deliver this kind of storytelling, but Battlefield 1 proves it’s more than just bullets and trenches. I’m officially hooked.

Simply put, this is one of the best multiplayer first person shooters ever.

Incredible graphics, animations, gameplay, sound and amazing maps. Much better than Battlefield V and Battlefield 2042.

19/12/2024 Edit: The EA anticheat has now been added to the game so the hackers are much less frequent. Highly recommended.

Although the game certainly isn't dead, if You're en English speaker, you're be disconnected from Asian servers (which are the closest to us with full lobbies), if you're a good player. More so if you dare mention being shot through walls more than once, once in a game.

The only Australian server that is full during peak play times, have some regulars that use cheats such as wall hacks and aim bot, but it's accepted becuase they're always on the side containing the server owners interests.

The American servers have been fine to play on, with rarely a cheater encountered.

I've only marked this as a "I do not recommend" game, because there's only a couple of servers where good players are welcome. For a player with only 400 odd hours into the game, hardly ever being able to play some games without either A) cheaters dominating the server for the server admin's interests and/or B) being kicked for being an English speaker, is a demonstration of community servers' interest in the games' future.

If you're cool with all of the above, I recommend. It was a fun 400 hrs, but I will not play it again. Otherwise, spend your money elswhere where you'll have a chance of it being appreciated/respected by the community that you'll be playing amongst.

November 11 2026, I have tried to download the game to play again (I am an old player, I had this game since 2020) only to find out now you have to provide some kind of personal ID, credit card or have your face scanned for KWS age check. EA is absolutely NOT getting my personal data now, uninstalling the game and will not be purchasing anything from EA again.

DO NOT buy this to play with friends. EA does not allow matchmaking outside of randoms through anything other than Origin, which remains completely broken and unusable. The campaigns work fine, and multiplayer on your own will work fine, but parties with friends do not work, and friends' lists glitch out from any use of it. This is enough of a dealbreaker for me. I'll play the game every once in a while, but after an hour of troubleshooting with other people over every possible solution to the matchmaking in the book, it's ruined any sense of decency the game has. play it on console, Origin is a cancer that does not deserve your time.

Finally finished the campaign after years of forgetting there was one. It’s pretty good.
But of course the multiplayer is what shines here, it’s just incredible.
Great variety of weapon, gear and vehicle options and the maps are extremely well designed.

The sound design, also, is insanely well done, hearing a tank shell whip past your head while artillery pound the ground around you is just amazing. Probably some of the best sound design I’ve ever heard in any game, ever. The vocal callouts in different languages as your enemies burn and the screams of the dying fill the air really adds to the atmosphere, it can get pretty intense. Pretty much all the game modes are enjoyable and the damage feedback during matches is super satisfying.

The World War I setting is definitely unique and sets this aside from the rest of the series.
Tank engagements and aerial dog fights basically never get old and the trench warfare is brutal as hell.
Operations Mode is some of the most fun I’ve ever had in any Battlefield game.
Wicked fun. Fantastic game.

By far the most immersive Battlefield game. I hold it, alongside Battlefield 4, as the best Battlefield games of all time. The sounds, the looks, the vehicles, the music. It's literally perfect and makes me feel like I'm a soldier in the Great War. It's far from accurate, but Dice did a great job of balancing accuracy with fun factor as much as they could and it turned out beautifully. This game is a must have for Battlefield fans.

Well, the game is a masterpiece. It looks incredible, the gameplay is awesome, the feeling of it is so damn good, and it's fun as hell. The absolutely best game in the series and also one of the best games I've ever played.

Campaign feels too casual with enemies spawning all around you, story I tried didn't seem engaging, just run and gun. Looks like it didn't even matter whether you headshot or legshot.

Also tried MP and it's really not that deep, with very low TTK & no teamwork, it's just a running / dying simulator. Time to kill is fast, so it's all about who spots who first, so camping corners & stairs is generally the best play (or just sniping prone) and you are not even sure what to do objective wise.

Re-spawning requires multiple key presses & got spawn camped repeatedly in my short session.

Game works alright tho, good controls & settings, soundtrack is cool, looks good, but just a bit bland and casual. Didn't do any vehicle stuff sadly.
